import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachFastOrbit(...): () => void {
  const originalSensibility = camera.angularSensibility;
  let baseSensibility = originalSensibility;
  let restoreSensibility: () => void;

  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(camera, "angularSensibility");
  if (descriptor && descriptor.configurable && descriptor.set === undefined && descriptor.get === undefined) {
    // Replace the plain field with a live half-sensibility getter.
    Object.defineProperty(camera, "angularSensibility", {
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: descriptor.enumerable,
      get() {
        return baseSensibility / 2;
      },
      set(value: number) {
        baseSensibility = value;
      },
    });
    restoreSensibility = () => {
      const finalBase = baseSensibility;
      if (descriptor.configurable) {
        Object.defineProperty(camera, "angularSensibility", descriptor);
      } else {
        delete (camera as any).angularSensibility;
      }
      (camera as any).angularSensibility = finalBase;
    };
  } else {
    camera.angularSensibility = originalSensibility / 2;
    restoreSensibility = () => {
      camera.angularSensibility = originalSensibility;
    };
  }

  const dispose = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });
  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    dispose();
    restoreSensibility();
  };
}

```ts
import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachFastOrbit(
  camera: ArcRotateCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
): () => void {
  const originalAngularSensibility = camera.angularSensibility;

  // The library's pointer rotation adds -dx / angularSensibility to
  // inertialAlphaOffset (and likewise for beta). Halving angularSensibility
  // therefore doubles both the immediate drag rotation and the inertia glide,
  // while leaving wheel/pinch zoom and pan sensitivity untouched.
  camera.angularSensibility = originalAngularSensibility / 2;

  const dispose = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene, { keyboard: false });

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;

    // Remove the library pointer controls first, then restore the camera field.
    dispose();
    camera.angularSensibility = originalAngularSensibility;
  };
}
```
